description: Use this when the user asks what import duty, customs duty, tariff, import tax or VAT applies to a tariff code or HS code, for example "what is the US duty on HTS 8507.60.00?", "what duty applies to UK commodity code 6914100000 from Vietnam?" or "what is under heading 6914 in the UK tariff?". Pass the code (4 to 10 digits, dots allowed), country GB or US, and originCountry when the user names where the goods come from. For a code goods are declared under it returns the description and the rate: for the UK the third-country duty, VAT rates as a list, the preferential rate and any additional duty for the origin, and other measures; for the US the general, special and column 2 rates and units. For a code that is only a heading it returns the lines beneath it instead. Chapter 99 additional duties for the US and quotas or trade remedies are not included. Do not use it for a landed cost estimate, for excise or customs-broker fees, or for legal advice.

code.description: Tariff code of 4 to 10 digits, with or without dots, for example 8517.13 or 6914900010.

country.description: Destination of the goods, whose import tariff to read: GB (United Kingdom Global Tariff) or US (Harmonized Tariff Schedule). The EU and other countries are not covered.

originCountry.description: Two-letter code of the country the goods come from, for example VN. Adds that country's preferential rate (GB) or tells whether the column 2 rate applies (US).

name: get_duty_rate
title: Get customs duty, tariff and import tax
